name: 61944 · Paris, IL
findings: ZIP 61944 (Paris) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61944 (Paris) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
61% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
